## Before you start {.study}

- **You need:** a phone or a computer with a browser, and PowerPoint for
  Task 1 (on a computer, on the web at `office.com`, or the phone app).
- **How it works:** watch the video of your teacher on the e-learning
  platform. Then do each Step on its simulator.
- **You submit:** `project.pptx` and the **tasks PDF** with your answers,
  one week after lecture 11. About 40 minutes.
- **The end of the course project:** the slides of the service that you
  chose in Online activity 10.

## Key terms {.study}

{{< glossary call-to-action marketing-plan ai-use-statement >}}

## Step 1 · A post for social media {.study}

- A **post** is one picture: a few words, the **call to action** (Order
  now, Book now), a theme and an icon.
- In PowerPoint one slide is the post: the title is the message, the
  subtitle is the call to action. **Design**: a theme. **Insert ›
  Icons**: an icon.

{{< sim file="sims/ppt-lab-post-online.html" poster="sims/ppt-lab-post-online.png" title="PowerPoint Lab: a post for social media" height="760" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · The post"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the theme|the icon"}
Which part of the post tells people what to do?
:   the call to action

    Why: Order now or Book now: the reader knows the next step.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · A short marketing plan {.study}

- A **marketing plan** is one table of six rows: the **goal** (a number
  and a time), the **audience**, the **message**, the **channels**, the
  **budget** and the **measure** (what you count).
- Build Mona's plan for her cakes, row by row.

{{< sim file="sims/plan-builder.html" poster="sims/plan-builder.png" title="Plan Builder: a short marketing plan" height="560" >}}

## Step 3 · Slides, and a slide added by AI {.study}

- **Slide 1**: the layout **Title Slide**. **Home › New Slide › Title and
  Content** for the next slides. **Design**: one theme.
- Only look and try: on **tutudocs.com** the **AI Assistant** can add a
  slide. The tasks do not need AI.

{{< sim file="sims/tutu-online.html" poster="sims/tutu-online.png" title="Tutu Lab: AI adds the last slide" height="700" >}}

## Tasks to submit {.tasks}

### Task 1 · The project slides

In PowerPoint make 3 slides, with one theme. Save them as `project.pptx`.

- **Slide 1** (Title Slide): the name of your service; the subtitle: your
  name.
- **Slide 2** (Title and Content): the title *Our post*; the text: the
  words of your post. Study Room: *Quiet room for group study · Book now*.
  Easy Print: *Your notes printed by tomorrow · Order now*. Fix It: *A new
  phone screen in one day · Book now*. Green Bites: *Healthy lunch for 2 JD
  · Order now*.
- **Slide 3** (Title and Content): the title *AI use*; the text: *I did not
  use AI.* (or, if AI helped you: *An AI assistant on tutudocs.com helped
  me.*)

*Submit:* `project.pptx`.

### Task 2 · Tap the answer

::: {.pick}
**a)** Which **goal** is good?

- be famous
- 20 orders this month
- many people
:::

::: {.pick}
**b)** Which **channels** reach students of the college?

- a poster in another city
- social media and the college e-mail
:::

::: {.pick}
**c)** What do you **count** to measure the plan?

- the responses of the form
- how nice the post looks
:::

### Task 3 · Type the answer

**a)** Which **layout** has slide 1 of your project? Type its name.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

**b)** The goal is 30 orders in January. The form has 24 responses. How
many orders are **missing**?

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## How to submit

Answer in the **Tasks PDF to fill in** and save it. Upload it with
`project.pptx`, **one week after lecture 11**.
